title: studio → a runner: one media job (a sequence's export, or a video take's frame)
description: From API 1.17 (contracts/README.md, Timeline: media jobs). Subject cmd.media.<host>.<env> (stream CMD, work queue; durable media-<host>-<env>, max_ack_pending 1, ack wait 60 s), Nats-Msg-Id <job_id>:1. `owner_id` = the user. Sent at once to the env studio chose (one whose hosts key has `media`). The runner works on it in a worker apart from runs and model jobs (ffmpeg on CPU or the media engine: no model, no GPU memory, no admission; it never counts as holding weights), sends `+WIP` every 10 s, checks KV `cancels` key <job_id> before it starts and at least every 2 s, publishes evt.media.status running, evt.media.progress, then one terminal status, waits for its ack, then acks the command. A redelivery starts over. Never bytes or URLs: inputs are object keys under u/<owner_id>/, outputs go under output_prefix.

inputs.description: every distinct object the job reads, once each (the runner downloads each into a 0700 temp dir); args name them by index. An export of empty slots only (black and silence) reads none; a frame job reads exactly one

output_prefix.description: export: u/<owner_id>/exports/<job_id>/ (export.mp4, export.poster.png, export.last.png); frame: u/<owner_id>/frames/<job_id>/ (frame.png)

mode.description: the plan's: copy = picture stream copy (concat demuxer), conform = re-encode; sound is re-encoded in both

frames.description: the sequence's length in frames (the progress total; the output must be within one frame of it)

samples.description: frames × sample_rate × den / num: the sound's length in samples

args.description: ffmpeg's arguments after the program name, built by studio (the one filter graph implementation), with placeholders the runner substitutes: `{in:<n>}` = the local absolute path of inputs[n], `{list}` = the concat list it writes from `concat`, `{out}` = the local output file, `{venc}` = its own video encoder arguments (expands to several: README, Timeline: media jobs). The runner refuses (failure `invalid`) a list with an `-i` not followed by `{in:<n>}` or `{list}`, a codec value (`-c`, `-c:v`, `-c:a`, `-codec*`, `-vcodec`, `-acodec`) other than copy, aac, rawvideo or pcm_s16le outside `{venc}`, an output other than `{out}`, or a filter that opens a file or URL (movie, amovie)

concat.description: copy: the inputs (by index) in clip order for the concat list (`file '<path>'` lines, `'` written as `'\''`)

expect.description: copy: the facts studio planned with, per video input; the runner probes each download and, when any differs, runs conform_args instead (reporting mode conform and the reason)

conform_args.description: copy: the conform arguments to fall back to (same placeholders)

frame.description: inputs[0] is the video: write that frame as PNG at the video's size

index.description: the frame number from 0 (last: the take's frames − 1)
